name: Chōsei (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Chōsei village emblem in yellow and white: a yellow lozenge with white strokes forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Chōsei, a village in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 11 May 1971; the emblem dates from 12 January 1971.

features.role: Chōsei village emblem — a yellow lozenge with white strokes forming a stylised character
